newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP wants gearing to fall to about 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: BHP wants gearing to fall to about 30 pct.

text.p: Australia's The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Monday it wanted to lower its debt-to-equity ratio by up to nine percentage points to around 30 percent.

"We would like to see it seven, or eight or nine percent lower, which it was several years ago, because this clearly gives us an opportunity for acquisitions," BHP's executive general manager for finance, Graeme McGregor said.
McGregor said, however, that BHP had not felt constrained in the past at making acquisitions that caused a short-term alteration to its level of gearing.

"We have a history, I think we have satisfied the rating agencies that if in fact we move our gearing temporarily above what might be seen as appropriate levels we have delivered on our committment to reduce the gearing back to an acceptable level," McGregor said.
